levels.surface: أحمد بن محمد بن أبي نصر

notes: Ubayd narrates that he mentioned Isma'il to Abu Abd Allah, and the Imam speaks (فقال), so the Imam is the last link (narrated encounter, example 4).
The chain is the Kamal's own shaykh chain; the compiler is not written.
أبي in the second place is the father, a relation.
